# Profile schema

The machine-readable schema is `profiles/schema.json`. Top-level fields:

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | yes | integer |
| `name` | yes | string |
| `description` | no | string |
| `site` | yes | string |
| `key_sets` | no | object |
| `tables` | no | object |
| `modules` | yes | array |
| `connections` | no | array |
| `economics` | no | object |

Every parameter value carries exactly one of `source` or `assumed: true` (`ADC-PRV-004`).
